children: SK hynix, the AI memory supplier

, gained 4.42% to 1,277,000 won on October 23. Solidigm ended its review of a potential IPO, citing capital-market conditions and share-price trends. That closes one proposed funding route for additional US production capacity. The investment need remains, and management continues to assess alternatives.

The cash demands extend beyond factories. SK hynix's board approved a 40 trillion won share repurchase and cancellation program in August. The company also outlined plans to return more than 50% of cumulative 20252027 free cash flow to shareholders. Those commitments put the financing mix in focus: how much Solidigm's expansion will require from the parent, and how much outside capital can cover.

The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 76 out of 100, with growth, profitability, financial strength and GF Value substantially stronger than momentum. That uneven profile gives investors a reason to look beyond Friday's gain. The next useful disclosure is a funded expansion plan with costs, timing and financing sources. Investors can then judge how comfortably factory spending and shareholder payouts fit together.

title: SK Hynix Stocks Gain 4.42% as Solidigm Ends IPO Review
